q: Who is The Die Cut Stickers?
a: A US custom sticker printer run from Phoenix, Arizona, producing die cut stickers, decals and labels for small businesses, brands, makers and event organizers. Orders are quoted individually, proofed for free and shipped by FedEx across the United States.

q: How long has The Die Cut Stickers been printing?
a: The business grew out of a packaging and label printing operation and has focused on custom shaped stickers for several years. The same team handles quoting, prepress and customer service, so the person who proofs your file is the one who answers your questions.

q: What kinds of customers do you print for?
a: Mostly small and mid-sized businesses: food and drink brands labeling products, retailers and makers sealing packaging, fleets branding vehicles, agencies ordering merch, and organizers printing event stickers. Personal and one-off orders are welcome at the 100-piece minimum.

q: Do you print in-house or outsource?
a: Production runs on our own offset and digital presses with in-house cutting and finishing, which is how we keep proofs free and turnaround at 5 to 7 business days. Specialty stocks are bought from US and European film suppliers and printed on the same equipment.

If a sticker arrives with a print defect, a cutting error or damage from shipping, we reprint it at no charge or refund it. Report the issue within 10 days with photos and we sort it out. Custom work that matches the approved proof is not returnable.

q: How do I contact a real person about an order?
a: Call (503) 461-4788 on weekdays or email info@thediecutstickers.com. Quote replies usually come within one business day. WhatsApp and the live chat on the site reach the same team during office hours.

q: Do you offer design help if I only have a rough idea?
a: Yes. Free design support covers cleaning up files, setting a cut line, simple layouts and type, and adapting an existing logo to a sticker size. Full illustration work is quoted separately, and we tell you up front if your request falls into that category.

q: Can you handle large or recurring orders?
a: Yes. Fleet sets, packaging runs of several thousand labels and monthly reorders are routine. Approved files are kept on your account so reorders skip the proof stage, and volume pricing is applied automatically once an order passes a few hundred pieces.

q: Are your materials and inks safe for packaging?
a: Our paper and film stocks are standard label-grade materials, and inks are the same UV and eco-solvent systems used across the US label industry. Tell us if a label will touch food directly or needs a specific compliance statement and we confirm the right stock before quoting.

q: Why choose a specialist sticker printer over a general print shop?
a: Die cutting, laminating and adhesive selection are where sticker orders go wrong, and they are what we do all day. A general shop prints the artwork; we also choose the film for the surface, set a cut line that survives, and tell you when a cheaper option would do the same job.
